LAYERED_RUNTIME.note: The layered runtime (runLayeredCreative), the plain-ground matte, the raster operations, the compositor under-composition mode, the readiness levels in the gate, the readiness verdict and the runtime parity probes: 138 mutants (137 without the no-op control). A first sweep killed 110; the 27 survivors were each answered by a new test (killed on the second and third sweeps) or documented here. Seven are documented, all equivalent or unreachable by construction: the foreground prop in the base under the product (the foreground band is above the product band, so the filter is the same), the plate band offset (z within its band, one plate), two props of one band (the production planner already refuses such a scene with PROVENANCE_BROKEN, so the runtime never sees it), an unmeasurable identity gate passing (a branch inherited from the single-image runtime that no fixture can reach), a failed preflight running (the same inherited branch; the layout engine honours the zones first), wired without its stages (the stage flags are constants that are all true in the real module; productionReadinessLevel tests them separately) and the always-true parity probe (a probe is a tautology unless the code it probes is broken, which the matte and runtime mutants do). PHASE 4 additions to the runtime (the shared layer store with reject / allowance / fork / export, the policy hooks drop_layers / anchors / typography, the layered artifact): the store and the artifact are swept with the REFINE component (below). A TIMEBOXED targeted sweep of the policy hooks and the repair allowance ran 17 mutants: 9 killed at once, 8 survived the first chain; 4 of those were then killed by the end-to-end repair tests and the Phase 3 tests LR-8 / LR-16 / LR-20, 3 real gaps (the prop-tool check of the runtime, an allowance of one candidate in the reservation and in the loop) got tests RF-27 / RF-28 that kill them, and 1 is documented as unreachable (in the top-up reservation, the clause that the key is not already reserved is implied by the cached candidates being non-empty). The remaining mutants of the hooks (the anchor override, the forced typography plate, the contents of the layered artifact) were NOT swept: they are asserted by RF-2, RF-5, RF-10, RF-17 and RF-21 (hashes of every layer, positions, plate, composite) but that is not a mutation result.

REFINE.note: The refine (src/creative-refine) swept with an in-house operator harness (comparisons, boolean and logical operators, negations, array methods, early returns, constants), against fast pure suites (PL, PE, EX, ST, RP; no image) : 454 mutants of the planner, defects, dependency map, masked-edit contract, memory, constants and parity audit, then 56 of the executor and the shared layer store. First pass 395 + 52 killed; the survivors were analysed, 9 + 3 real gaps got guard tests that kill them (re-run and killed), the planner policy became a parameter, dead checks were removed and the executor was made testable with an injectable runtime. DOCUMENTED (51): 19 nullish defaults (?? to ||: the left operand is only ever null, undefined or an object / array), 28 conjunctions inside the probes of the parity audit itself (each conjunct is asserted by its own PL / PE / RF test), 3 equivalent shapes in the PNG-mask reader (a row past the buffer, a -1 / -2 sentinel), 1 equivalent merge (a policy key present on one side only is already kept by the spread). Not covered by mutation: the end-to-end behaviour, which is asserted by RF-1 to RF-28 (real layered runtime, real gates, real compositor and typography). CLOSURE: classifyCandidate and the unmeasured-repair acceptance (24 mutants, all killed after EX-9).

INTEGRATION.note: TARGETED sweep (owner rule: identity decisions, fail-closed thresholds, routing; no sweep of image-processing plumbing) with the in-house operator harness: 484 mutants of identity.js, relight.js (bounds, clip measure, grade proposal), placement.js, the shadow request check, the segmentation contract (validate / port / cache) and the integrate.js routing, against the fast suites (identity, matte, segmentation, shadow, pipeline). First pass 227 killed / 257 survived; the 69 logical survivors were analysed, real gaps got guard tests (creative-integration-guards.test.js, GD-1..GD-25: identity fail-closed on size / interior / each channel, every contract violation alone, the reasons being exactly the failed checks, declarations reaching the segmenter and the matte check, placement and shadow-request decisions, hue for every dominant channel) and the survivors were re-run: 275 killed in total. DOCUMENTED (209): 188 numeric-literal and boundary mutants in pixel arithmetic (+1 on a constant, < to <=, >= to >) of the image plumbing, which the owner told us not to sweep, asserted only qualitatively; 21 equivalent or unreachable by construction: the redundant size guard of sameAlpha (the size is checked before), the constant alpha_exact switch, the semi-transparent interior redundancy in the detail mask (interior is a subset of alpha >= 128), two hue-angle branch flips whose effect is also caught by the chromaticity check, the exact-equality boundary of the chromaticity / hue limits, extent +-1 in the placement boxes (7), and three integrate.js flips of the identity-risk branch (relight bounds imply identity, so the branch is defence in depth and not reachable with an explicit grade within the bounds) and of the colour-not-measurable branch (unreachable once segmentation succeeded). Kill rate 57 %: stated, not hidden. Not mutation-covered: segmentation internals (analysis, split, unmix), matte-quality internals, shadow geometry, visual output, which are asserted by SG / MQ / SH / AR / PI tests on drawn products.

END_TO_END.note: TARGETED sweep (routing, fail-closed decisions, budget enforcement, operation-id uniqueness, checkpoint invalidation, provenance/identity) of src/creative-e2e/run-context.js (72 mutants), src/creative-integration/native-alpha.js (255) and the routing/gate decisions of src/creative-e2e/e2e.js (29), with the in-house operator harness. First sweep: 132 killed, 224 survivors; two rounds of guard tests (EG-1..13, RT-27..30) killed 23 more and one unreachable state was deleted. The 201 survivors are classified in docs/architecture/creative-end-to-end.md 11.3: 185 in the native-alpha quality validation (107 are +-1 on a calibrated numeric limit, 78 are loop-bound no-ops, findings-list-only changes before a return fail(), or branches duplicated by an independent check), 12 in the run context (4 equivalent because of the 1e-12 tolerance, the rest trace counters and cosmetic ledger text), 4 in e2e.js (headline-code priority when two gates fail, ceiling 0 caught one step later, a critic estimate constant). The +-1 boundaries of the native-alpha limits are NOT pinned by tests (recommended for later); no routing, budget, operation-id, checkpoint or identity decision survives. CLOSURE (NDR-P28): a further targeted sweep of the new decision code, 160 mutants: claims.js, consistency.js, campaign.js (109: 105 killed, 4 equivalent in the amount parser: a separator at index 0, a single-element .some), run-context budget refusal and the status model (16: 13 killed, 3 documented: a trace counter, two epsilon-equivalent comparisons), the budget mapping, claim and consistency wiring of e2e.js (11: 9 killed, 2 documented redundant fallbacks: the catch-all also maps a refusal to BUDGET_EXCEEDED, and a refusal with an image already delivered cannot be provoked by a scripted port). Two real gaps were found by the sweep and closed by tests (amount parsing, segmentation sharing / defaults, the unmeasured-repair acceptance, a refine refused by the ceiling).
